title: Roaring "Blade"
description: the knight has risen eyes emoji
body:
Just a simple retexture I did in like 10 minutes, don't expect much. It replaces the diamond and netherite swords with the chipped and normal versions of "The Roaring Knight's" blade.

_Hope you like it I guess._
